title: Separate optional package exports
scope: Define loader, validation, scene, driver, conformance and benchmark package boundaries without dangling exported targets.
acceptance: Minimal and selected-component installations fail cleanly for absent required components.
Each supported package combination passes relocated external-consumer checks.
